shortDescription.default: WYSIWYG form designer for SharePoint lists

longDescription.default: Form Designer lets you design SharePoint list forms with drag and drop – tabs, sections, validation, default values, form script, header with icon and logo, panel or dialog display – in German and English, and deploys them as a list form customizer.

features.title: Form Designer
features.description: Designer web part, form runtime (list form customizer) and panel extension (ListView command set).
